stories.title: Últimas noticias de la Asamblea General de la ONU, en directo | Trump amenaza con “aniquilar” Irán si no hay pacto, pero augura un acuerdo tras las elecciones de noviembre

en.title: Latest news from the UN General Assembly, live | Trump threatens to "annihilate" Iran if there is no deal, but predicts an agreement after November elections
en.summary: At the UN General Assembly, the US president delivered a speech claiming credit for peace achievements. The UN Secretary-General called for artificial intelligence to be shaped for humanity's benefit, while Brazil's president emphasized the critical moment for the United Nations.

stories.title: Donald Trump, en la Asamblea General de la ONU: "Aniquilaré Irán y Cuba caerá"

en.title: Donald Trump, at the UN General Assembly: "I will annihilate Iran and Cuba will fall"
en.summary: The US president stated at the UN that the country will not tolerate threats in the Americas and warned of using unmatched military power if necessary against regional adversaries.

stories.title: Sánchez traslada a Delcy su compromiso con Venezuela durante la asamblea de la ONU

en.title: Sánchez conveys to Delcy his commitment to Venezuela during the UN assembly
en.summary: Spain's prime minister met with Venezuela's interim president at the UN General Assembly in New York and expressed Spain's commitment to Venezuela and the region's future.

stories.title: Trump enfada a Cuba e Irán ante la ONU, que abandonan la asamblea durante su discurso

en.title: Trump angers Cuba and Iran at the UN, which abandon the assembly during his speech
en.summary: Cuba and Iran left the UN General Assembly during the US president's address at the 81st session, which included numerous world leaders gathered in New York.

stories.title: Crisis en Ceuta y actualidad política, directo | Interior presupuesta 9 millones para reforzar la frontera marítima de El Tarajal e impedir la entrada a nado de migrantes

en.title: Crisis in Ceuta and political news, live | Interior budgets 9 million to reinforce El Tarajal maritime border and prevent migrants from entering by swimming
en.summary: Spain's Interior Ministry is allocating 9 million euros to strengthen the maritime border at El Tarajal in Ceuta to prevent unauthorized migrant crossings. The government plans to open additional accommodation spaces for migrants while the foreign minister meets with Morocco to address migrant returns.

stories.title: Interior inicia los trámites para construir una baliza 'antitrepa' y 'antibuceo' en la frontera de El Tarajal, rota desde hace días

en.title: Interior initiates procedures to build an 'anti-climbing' and 'anti-diving' beacon at El Tarajal border, damaged for days
en.summary: Spain's Interior Ministry is beginning procedures to construct a specialized barrier extending to the seabed at El Tarajal's maritime border. The 9-million-euro infrastructure requires approval and reports from Ceuta's autonomous city government.

stories.title: Interior inicia los trámites para acometer la prolongación del espigón de El Tarajal

en.title: Interior initiates procedures to undertake the extension of El Tarajal pier
en.summary: Spain's Interior Ministry is beginning procedures to extend El Tarajal's pier to reinforce the border with Morocco. The extension aims to comply with a Supreme Court ruling requiring a physical barrier to enforce deportations.

stories.title: El Congreso retira a Vito Quiles la credencial de prensa definitivamente

en.title: Congress permanently removes Vito Quiles' press credential
en.summary: Congress has permanently revoked the press accreditation of EDATV employee Vito Quiles for accumulated serious violations, marking the first time this maximum sanction has been applied since the regulations were reformed.

stories.title: El Congreso retira definitivamente la acreditación de prensa a Vito Quiles por reiteradas faltas "muy graves"

en.title: Congress permanently removes Vito Quiles' press accreditation for repeated "very serious" violations
en.summary: Congress has permanently revoked the press credentials of journalist Vito Quiles following repeated serious infractions, with the decision approved by PSOE and Sumar votes while the PP abstained.

stories.title: El Congreso expulsa definitivamente a Vito Quiles tras acumular una decena de sanciones

en.title: Congress permanently expels Vito Quiles after accumulating a dozen sanctions
en.summary: Spain's Chamber of Deputies permanently revoked the parliamentary accreditation of ultra-activist Vito Quiles following numerous sanctions. The decision was approved by votes from the Socialist Party and Sumar political groups.

stories.title: El Congreso retira definitivamente la acreditación de prensa a Vito Quiles

en.title: Congress permanently revokes press accreditation from Vito Quiles
en.summary: Spain's Congress has permanently suspended a journalist's access to the lower chamber due to repeated violations of regulations.

stories.title: Sánchez no irá a la recepción que ofrece Trump por la Asamblea General de la ONU

en.title: Sánchez will not attend reception offered by Trump at UN General Assembly
en.summary: Spain's president will skip a reception hosted by the US president at the United Nations, citing schedule conflicts despite having no official commitments at that time.

stories.title: Sánchez garantiza a Delcy Rodríguez el compromiso de España con Venezuela

en.title: Sánchez assures Delcy Rodríguez of Spain's commitment to Venezuela
en.summary: Venezuela's interim president requests dialogue with Spain's government on the country's future during the United Nations General Assembly.

stories.title: El Ibex se desinfla al cierre y sube un tímido 0,15% en una jornada muy volátil

en.title: Ibex deflates at close and rises a modest 0.15% in a highly volatile session
en.summary: Spain's main stock index gained marginally after initial optimism faded, with oil recovering above 100 dollars and technology stocks losing momentum.

stories.title: Trump reivindica su guerra contra Irán y asegura que "el precio del petróleo caerá en picado"

en.title: Trump claims his war against Iran and asserts that "oil price will plummet"
en.summary: The US president delivered a triumphalist speech at the UN stating that preventing Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons was necessary and warned Tehran that failure to sign an agreement would result in catastrophic consequences for the country.

stories.title: El precio del petróleo cae a 98 dólares tras indicar Arabia Saudí la reapertura del oleoducto Este-Oeste

en.title: Oil price falls to 98 dollars after Saudi Arabia indicates reopening of East-West pipeline
en.summary: Saudi crude oil prices declined following the announcement of a key pipeline reopening to the Red Sea, which had been closed for two weeks following drone attacks.

stories.title: Sánchez planta a Trump en la recepción de la ONU

en.title: Sánchez snubs Trump at UN reception
en.summary: Spain's prime minister cited scheduling conflicts to explain his absence from a UN event, reflecting tension in relations with the US president.
